scope: Explicit user request: evaluate comparable published methods. Pending adapter/bundle states are not running jobs or measured results.

methods.name: Life-Harness
methods.reason_zh: 公开内置产物四场景三遍完成；WebShop补测中。论文最终进化包身份未确认。
methods.reason_en: Four completed triple evaluations; WebShop running. Paper-final bundle identity unconfirmed.

methods.name: ALIGN
methods.reason_zh: 已核实原论文与代码，需将已释放接口接入固定题单；论文转引成绩不冒充本地复测。
methods.reason_en: Official paper/code verified; released interfaces require a fixed-task native adapter.

methods.name: AgentSquare
methods.reason_zh: 模块化规划、推理、工具、记忆；公开运行入口存在，尚未完成我们的Qwen端点及题单适配。
methods.reason_en: Public runtime exists; Qwen endpoint and fixed-task adaptation not completed.

methods.name: Meta-Harness
methods.reason_zh: Life提供原生搜索入口，但未定位与其表格成绩绑定的最终包；从头搜索与产物复测分开排期。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native search entrypoints; a score-bound final bundle has not been located.

methods.name: AHE
methods.reason_zh: 已有Life原生适配入口；最终产物缺失时需要实际重新搜索，不能把空Harness当论文产物。
methods.reason_en: Life supplies native adaptation. Missing final bundles require an actual new search, not empty policies.

methods.name: HarnessX
methods.reason_zh: 原结果不同模型、pass@2、同任务进化峰值；当前公开树未定位论文场景的最终产物与完整适配。
methods.reason_en: Different actors, pass@2 peaks on adaptation tasks; final benchmark bundles/adapters not located.

methods.name: SkillOpt
methods.reason_zh: 需论文对应Skill与执行Harness；已有SkillOpt风格本地实验不能冒充原作者复现。
methods.reason_en: Requires paper-matched skills and executor harness; local SkillOpt-inspired runs are not original reproductions.

methods.name: SkillFM
methods.reason_zh: Qwen3-4B结果存在；需核实生成器权重、额外模型调用与任务划分后运行。
methods.reason_en: Qwen3-4B rows exist; generator weights, auxiliary calls and splits must be aligned.

methods.name: Reflexion
methods.reason_zh: 多次尝试与反馈是方法的一部分；必须报告first-attempt及额外尝试成本，不能冒充冻结单遍。
methods.reason_en: Repeated attempts/feedback are part of the method; separate first-attempt and additional-attempt cost.

methods.name: ReflAct
methods.reason_zh: 原论文可查；按其原始指令与示例接入，保持相同测试题与执行预算。
methods.reason_en: Use original instructions/examples with shared tasks and execution budgets.

methods.name: AutoManual
methods.reason_zh: 需冻结训练阶段生成的手册，并区分生成手册与测试期间更新。
methods.reason_en: Freeze training-derived manuals and distinguish manual generation from test-time adaptation.

methods.name: GEPA
methods.reason_zh: 通用优化方法；本场景需原生适配与真实搜索，不直接转抄其他任务结果。
methods.reason_en: A general optimizer; these tasks require a native adapter and actual optimization.

methods.name: HarnessOpt
methods.reason_zh: 作为完整Harness搜索参照；确认共享场景与冻结权重协议后才入主榜。
methods.reason_en: Full-harness search reference; benchmark overlap and frozen-weight protocol still require verification.
